acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
The mass spectrometer worked in a data-dependent mode.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Proteins were reduced with TCEP and alkylated with iodoacetamide.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were then digested overnight with trypsin (enzyme-protein mg ratio 1:50) at 37 ˚C.

Carbamidomethylation of cysteines was set as a fixed modification, oxidation of methionine as variable modification and trypsin was set as cleavage specificity allowing a maximum of 2 missed cleavages.

collision_energy.evidence: the 10 most abundant peptides were subjected to HCD fragmentation with NCE of 25.

fragmentation_method.evidence: the 10 most abundant peptides were subjected to HCD fragmentation with NCE of 25.

instrument.evidence: Peptides were analysed with an Orbitrap Q-Exactive mass spectrometer coupled to an EASY nanoLC 1000 system via a Nano Flex ion source.

labeling.evidence: inferred: Raw files were processed with Proteome Discoverer 2.5 (Thermo Fisher) for quantitative analysis.
